name: hyper-taste
description: Agent skills with taste: interfaces that don't look generated, and agent instruction files that stay small.

plugins.name: hyper-taste
plugins.description: Every Hyper Taste skill in one install: ui-director and agents-md.

plugins.name: ui-director
plugins.description: Art direction for any UI: seven finished gold pages to start from (landings, dashboards, a phone app), a token system for any stack, and a check that looks at the result in a real browser at desktop, tablet and phone widths.

plugins.name: agents-md
plugins.description: Keep AGENTS.md small and every agent in sync: CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md become symlinks (or an @AGENTS.md import), an audit flags bloat, imports and stale paths, and a clear rule for what belongs in AGENTS.md, docs/ or a skill.
